subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from gateway `config.patch`?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix changes Feishu's public config shape and may affect the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the nested preview config while preserving current defaults, with focused tests and docs, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Only reduce progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu streaming boolean-only and make progress copy less alarming, which is smaller but still leaves no way to keep streaming while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse streaming toggle
options.body: Allow gateway `config.patch` to change `channels.feishu.streaming`, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled path and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the nested preview config while preserving current defaults, with focused tests and docs, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Feishu Card Kit streaming path and current boolean config surface that this decision would extend.
